name: Multi-Level Morton Code Data Structure
aliases: Multi-level Data Structure for Adaptive SPH
definition: A method to create multiple distinct data structures for different cell sizes on the same underlying particle data by utilizing the self-similarity of the Morton code, allowing efficient neighbor searches at various scales.
summary: The Multi-Level Morton Code Data Structure enables efficient multi-scale neighbor searches by storing distinct spatial hash grids for varying cell sizes in a single continuous memory layout, avoiding redundant data structures.
